name: Atkins-Friendly Chocolate Mousse
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 cup (240 ml) or 1 part half and half
1 cup (240 ml) or 1 part heavy cream
4 scoops or 1 part Atkins Chocolate Shake Mix
2 tsp or 1/24 part stevia extract or other sugar replacement

steps: Lightly whip half and half and cream in a blender.

culture.text: A mousse is a soft, prepared food that incorporates air bubbles to give it a light and airy texture. Depending on preparation techniques, it can range from light and fluffy to creamy and thick. A mousse may be sweet or savory.
